steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Configure a technical stage for evaluation scoring.
Move to the technical stage before configuring its template and questions.
Select the Evaluation Matrix template required for section scoring.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Populate the technical questions, including the section to be scored.
Assign the evaluator who will score the vendor response.
Add a vendor so the technical stage receives a response.
Publish the event so the vendor can answer.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Submit the vendor's technical response for evaluation.
Confirm the vendor response was accepted.
Close the technical round so evaluation becomes available.
Use the assigned evaluator flow to score the vendor's technical response.

args.goal: On the evaluator's technical scoring screen, assign scores to every question in one section, read the section total shown at the top of that section, and verify that it equals the sum of the question scores entered; stop when the matching section total is visible.

steps.note: Perform and verify the section-level auto-sum, which is not exposed by a dedicated catalog assertion.
Confirm no error appeared while saving or displaying the section total.
